info.title: Nimbusware API
info.description: Nimbusware control-plane HTTP API (orchestrates the Nimbusware online agentic system). Resource paths are under /v1. Operations are tagged **user** (Maker product loop) or **admin** (Admin Console / control plane). Individual edition: user routes are open locally; admin routes require ``X-Nimbusware-Admin-Token``. Enterprise: user routes need ``X-Nimbusware-Api-Key`` with ``maker_user`` scope; admin routes need ``maker_admin`` scope or the admin token (bootstrap). See README (User vs Admin) for the full split.

200.description: Replayed canonical events for the run plus top-level read-model summaries (``integrator_gate`` / ``self_refinement`` optional keys are presence-gated; degraded-metadata skip-vs-emit differs per helper): ``integrator_gate`` (latest; optional ``bundle_compatibility_ranking`` pipeline inputs, ``selected_bundle_rank``, ``selected_bundle_id``), ``integrator_gate_history`` (chronological gate decisions, bounded), ``integrator_gate_delta`` (latest vs prior gate when at least two decisions exist), ``agent_evaluator`` (optional ``auto_promote`` / ``auto_create_persona`` nested objects plus flattened ``auto_promote_*`` / ``auto_create_*`` scalar fields when present; ``evaluation_branch`` rules vs ``rules_with_llm_policy``; ``llm_evaluation_summary`` / ``llm_evaluation_status`` when LLM policy ran), ``self_refinement`` (latest ``self_refinement:policy`` marker plus optional evaluation fields ``evaluation_status`` / ``evaluation_gaps`` / ``promotion_ready`` / ``coverage_*`` / ``max_iterations`` / ``max_iterations_exceeded`` / flattened ``auto_promote_*`` when present, ``phase_d_signal`` (latest ``self_refinement.loop.signalled`` event with attempt/max-iterations snapshot, rules gate, optional LLM branch ``orchestration_branch`` / ``llm_critique_*`` fields for Phase D), ``llm_critique_stage`` (latest ``self_refinement.critique`` gate panel verdict when emitted), ``llm_critique_summary`` from stage metadata when present, ``marker_count`` session total, ``first_marker_occurred_at``, and ``last_marker_occurred_at`` when markers exist; omitted when ``NIMBUSWARE_SELF_REFINEMENT_STAGE_MARKER`` is ``0``/``false``/``no``), ``self_refinement_marker_history`` (chronological policy markers, bounded), ``run_escalated`` (latest), ``run_escalated_history`` (chronological bounded list), ``run_escalated_delta`` (latest vs prior when at least two escalations exist), ``security_scan_on_verify`` (latest), ``security_scan_on_verify_history`` (bounded chronological list), ``preflight`` (latest ``model.preflight.passed`` projection — provider, validated model id, p95 latency, multisample count, and per-sample ``health_latency_samples_ms`` when persisted; null when preflight was skipped via ``NIMBUSWARE_SKIP_PREFLIGHT``), and ``scraper_fetch`` (latest terminal ``scraper:fetch`` ``stage.passed`` / ``stage.failed`` with fetch count, total bytes, failure ``reason_code`` when set, and capped ``fetches`` per-URL rows when present), and ``universal_critique`` (latest ``gate.decision.emitted`` per ``*.critique`` stage with ``producer_taxonomy_key`` alignment and ``stage_count`` / ``fail_count`` / ``pass_count`` rollups, ``distinct_fail_stages``, plus optional ``critique_coverage`` frozen from first ``run.created``), and ``persona_assignment`` (frozen composite persona ids from the first ``run.created`` when present), ``stage_graph`` (``stage_count``, ``parallel_group_count``, ``ordered_stage_names`` from frozen ``run.created`` metadata), ``parallel_writer_groups`` (writer parallel-group gate pass/fail rollups, ``dispatch_mode``, per-stage ``stage_details``), and ``critic_matrix_live`` (orchestration gate matrix rows + summary).

k.title: K
k.description: Echoed bounded ``k`` (1..20) that the response was sized to. Matches the ``k`` echoed by the bundle catalog search payload so API and console clients can deduplicate hits consistently.

faiss_index_ready.title: Faiss Index Ready
faiss_index_ready.description: True when both ``configs/bundles/index/faiss.index`` and ``configs/bundles/index/bundle_order.json`` exist under the orchestrator repo root, signaling that ``search_bundles`` used the FAISS top-k path (rather than the tag/id fallback) for this response. Mirrors the console FAISS readiness caption.

faiss_index_stale.title: Faiss Index Stale
faiss_index_stale.description: ``True`` when both index files exist and ``configs/bundles/catalog.yaml`` is newer than the index files (rebuild recommended). ``False`` when both index files exist and the catalog is not newer. ``None`` when the index is incomplete or the catalog is missing — same semantics as ``bundle_faiss_index_sync_state`` ``stale`` in ``extensions.catalog``.

operator_settings.title: Operator Settings
operator_settings.description: Per-run operator overrides (run-scoped catalog keys only).

autopilot_profile_id.title: Autopilot Profile Id
autopilot_profile_id.description: Saved operator autopilot profile to apply at run start

enforcement_profile_id.title: Enforcement Profile Id
enforcement_profile_id.description: Saved operator enforcement profile to apply at run start

standards_profile_id.title: Standards Profile Id
standards_profile_id.description: Saved standards profile to apply at run start

note.title: Note
note.default: External webhook for run steering from Slack/Teams/etc. In-product operator chat: Maker Chat (#/chat) and Admin operator chat.

embedding_mode.title: Embedding Mode
embedding_mode.description: deterministic or ollama; default auto-selects ollama when LLM enabled

emit_event.title: Emit Event
emit_event.description: Append hardware.profile.detected to the event store when true

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Run to attach the hardware.profile.detected event (required when emit_event)

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: Install method: winget, brew, download, script, or null for auto

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Per-persona system-prompt / operating instructions. NFC-normalized server-side; <= 8000 chars.

PersonaEntry.title: PersonaEntry
PersonaEntry.description: One persona row on a shelf (``id`` / ``display_name`` plus optional extended fields).

PersonaShelfPatchRequest.title: PersonaShelfPatchRequest
PersonaShelfPatchRequest.description:
Body for ``PATCH /v1/personas/{shelf}/{id}`` (partial update).

Every field besides ``expected_version`` is optional; only the keys present
in the request mutate the persona on disk.

PersonaShelfUpsertRequest.title: PersonaShelfUpsertRequest
PersonaShelfUpsertRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /v1/personas/{shelf}`` and ``PUT /v1/personas/{shelf}/{id}``.

``expected_version`` is REQUIRED for PUT (optimistic concurrency) and is
silently ignored on POST (server assigns ``version=1`` on create).

PersonaShelvesResponse.title: PersonaShelvesResponse
PersonaShelvesResponse.description:
Merged ``business_area`` + ``development_role`` entries from ``shelves.yaml``.

Entries follow the :class:`PersonaEntry` shape but are kept as ``dict`` here so
callers that read raw fields keep working; the route handlers run
everything through :class:`PersonaEntry` validation before responding.

PreflightHistoryEntry.title: PreflightHistoryEntry
PreflightHistoryEntry.description: One run's latest preflight projection (same shape as timeline ``preflight``).

SubscriptionOauthProviderStatus.title: SubscriptionOauthProviderStatus
SubscriptionOauthProviderStatus.description: One subscription provider OAuth readiness row (`sak448-d`).

TimelinePanelsResponse.title: TimelinePanelsResponse
TimelinePanelsResponse.description: Admin timeline panel summaries — null panels stay in JSON for stable keys.

WorkUnitClaimResponse.title: WorkUnitClaimResponse
WorkUnitClaimResponse.description: Claim response: empty poll stays via=broker; miss uses via=broker_miss (`sak440-g`).

tags.name: user
tags.description: Maker product routes. Individual: implicit local user. Enterprise: ``maker_user`` API key scope.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Admin Console / control plane. Individual: ``X-Nimbusware-Admin-Token``. Enterprise: ``maker_admin`` scope or admin token.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Run list (pagination, filters, keyset), detail, timeline, findings, and lifecycle transitions.

tags.name: actions
tags.description: Run-scoped actions (retry, escalate) and admin role execute.

tags.name: bundles
tags.description: Read-only bundle catalog helpers: ``GET /v1/bundles/search`` performs bounded vector search (``k`` capped by server defaults) under the frozen repo root; each **200** response includes ``faiss_index_ready`` (and related index hints) when the optional FAISS index is present.

tags.name: preflight
tags.description: Fleet preflight history (``GET /v1/preflight-history``) — bounded aggregation over recent runs without per-run timeline fan-out.

tags.name: platform
tags.description: Product edition, local readiness, and feature gates.

tags.name: projects
tags.description: Project workspaces bound to agent runs. ``GET/POST`` are user routes; ``DELETE`` is admin-only.

tags.name: enterprise
tags.description: Enterprise edition routes (404 when NIMBUSWARE_EDITION=individual). IAM routes require X-Nimbusware-Api-Key on Enterprise.

tags.name: scraper-artifacts
tags.description: Read-only on-disk scraper artifact inventory under the configured cache directory.
